73:20.text: almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and
a group of those with you. And Allāh determines
the night and the day. He has known that you
will not be able to do it
and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy
of the Qur’ān. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking
of the bounty of Allāh and others fighting for the cause of Allāh. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakāh and loan Allāh a goodly loan.
And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allāh. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

74:6.text: And do not confer favor to acquire more

74:7.text: But for your Lord be patient.

74:8.text: And when the trumpet is blown,

74:9.text: That Day will be a difficult day

74:11.text: Leave Me with the one I created alone

74:12.text: And to whom I granted extensive wealth

74:15.text: Then he desires that I should add more.

74:16.text: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.

74:17.text: I will cover him with arduous torment.
